evidence.observation: Pressure 3.014 Torr at start of growth, matching the ~3.00 Torr seen through the ramp at 100 sccm.
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.251 Torr (+0.24 Torr in 480 s) with no change in setpoints.
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the rise is not caused by a flow change.
Temperature stable at 750 °C and heater power steady at ~45%, so a thermal cause is unlikely.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so the growth atmosphere cannot be checked and air getting in cannot be ruled out.
